repo_head: 63449b1 public-launch (repairs 87e7f57, audits 1b76fac committed before this file); no model in this campaign was fit before this freeze
scope: research only: the pinned grader tools/accuracy_registry.py, prereg chain seqs 1-113, production models and the paper book are untouched

panel.note: bars 1d, common equity per research/harness/instruments.py, delisted symbols kept

features.alignment: the stored row at day index i+1 is the feature vector of origin i (lab.py shift(1) undone), so origin features use data through the origin close and nothing later

datasets.live_db: data/signaldeck.db read-only; not hashed; every read stamped generated_at_utc

sealed.research/dirfix/HOLDOUT.json: opened 2026-08-15 per its README, so not a live seal; nested walk-forward plus the live forward record replace it

direction.target: up = close[i+h]/close[i]-1 > 0 at origin i (zero is down); h in sessions

baselines.B0: prequential majority over all eligible rows of strictly earlier days; a tie or empty prior skips the day for every model
baselines.B2: sign of the prior h-session return

candidates.M1: logistic L2, C in [0.01, 0.1, 1.0], median impute and standardise fit on train
candidates.M2: HGB max_depth 3, max_iter 150, lr 0.06, min_samples_leaf 500, l2 1.0, random_state 0
candidates.M3: HGB max_depth 6, max_iter 300, lr 0.05, min_samples_leaf 200, l2 1.0, random_state 0
candidates.M4: market-only logistic C 0.1 on mkt_mean_ret, mkt_mean_ret_5, mkt_mean_ret_21, mkt_dispersion, mkt_breadth

calibration: isotonic fit on inner-fold out-of-sample predictions only
direction.abstention: threshold on |p-0.5| chosen on inner folds to keep the 20 percent most confident rows; coverage and the risk-coverage curve disclosed

inner.criterion: mean log loss; ties to the simpler model

direction.primary_metric: skill_pp = 100*(accuracy - B0 accuracy) on matched rows

mpui.rule: corrected 95 percent lower bound above 0 pooled and in at least 4 of 6 blocks; the +20pp plan figure is a stretch target no evidence supports

uncertainty.method: circular block bootstrap of per-block skill

direction.multiplicity: Holm over every model x horizon x feature_set x calibration evaluated on outer blocks; ablations and controls count toward the family
direction.stopping_rule: after blocks 1-3 a candidate with mean skill_pp <= 0 whose inner log loss did not beat the base rate is STOPPED and logged

controls.C1: within-day label shuffle of training labels
controls.void_rule: any control with |skill_pp| > 1.0 and a CI excluding 0 voids the campaign as leaky

direction.incumbent: no historical forecasts exist; the matched comparison is limited to graded live rows 2026-07-24..2026-08-13 (the collapsed window) and is exploratory

structural.targets: frozen resolver labels (research/forecastplan/labels.py, parity 287/0) for trend21, liquidity21, vol21; crypto kinds excluded
structural.incumbent: PredictTrend / PredictLiquidity / PredictVol21 ported from structregime.go (call = current side, conviction = trailing-200 percentile, minHistory 260)
structural.baseline: naive persistence label frozen at the origin (what regime_outcomes.naive_label stores live)
structural.eligibility: the direction screen plus 260 prior bars; a no-screen variant as sensitivity
structural.sampling: train on all origins with purge 21 and embargo 21; evaluate on non-overlapping origins every 21 sessions from 2019-07-26 (offsets 7 and 14 as sensitivity)
structural.primary_metric: skill_pp = 100*(accuracy - persistence accuracy) on matched origins
structural.mpui: +1.0 pp with corrected lower bound above 0, or balanced accuracy +5.0 pp with accuracy within 0.5 pp of persistence
structural.multiplicity: Holm over kinds x models x framings x screens
structural.filingsdrift21: no verified public-availability dataset in this campaign; retrospective comparisons are exploratory; the prospective baseline proposal is documented, not filed

volatility.registered: prereg seq 105 metrics, floors and verdicts unchanged
volatility.target: RV^GK daily variance floored at 1e-8 exactly as tools/rv_forecast_backtest.py rv_series; horizons 1 and 5; QLIKE = a/f - ln(a/f) - 1
volatility.universe: the tool screen: stocks, at least 530 bars, flat-session share below 1 percent, companies_only false
baselines: HAR incumbent (tool fit_at and predict_at, refit every 5 sessions)
volatility.primary_metric: per-day-cluster mean QLIKE difference candidate minus HAR; DM t with the tool Newey-West lag; block bootstrap 21
volatility.mpui: relative QLIKE improvement vs HAR of at least 1 percent with corrected lower bound above 0 at h=1

ledger.rule: every attempted fit is logged, failures included; fits, resamples, simulations and prospective observations are labelled

promotion_to_shadow: only a candidate meeting its family MPUI with clean controls enters a separately identified shadow series; research success never authorises publication or replacing the incumbent
amendments: append-only: any change is a new manifest_id with a stated reason; v1 results stay labelled v1
